This small plot is my enset and some coffee trees mixed together, just beside my house. I do not buy fertilizer from the cooperative for these trees — I never have, and my mother never did either. What I do is throw the kitchen ash, the cattle dung from our one cow, and the banana leaves and weeds right there at the base of the trees. That is what keeps them growing. For such a small piece of land with trees I planted years ago from my neighbor's suckers, spending cash on chemical fertilizer makes no sense to me — the rain here is enough, and I weed and mulch with my own hands when I have time between the bigger plots.
